title: Aureline M5 constrained-state-descriptor change diff
description: Canonical per-domain constrained-state-change-diff record minted by the constrained-state-descriptor and change-diff lane over the frozen M5 constrained-file-state matrix. Turns a change in the constrained-state descriptor of a read-only, generated, policy-locked, managed, projection, or captured-snapshot object into visible, machine-checkable truth instead of a silent in-place mutation: it records the diff scope a descriptor change sits in — a state-class change (the constrained state-class the object belongs to changed), a canonical-source change (the canonical source or backing object the constrained object relates back to changed), or a write-target change (the exact write target a write-capable action would touch changed). Names the diff scope, binds the resolved object identity, the affected descriptor-field reference, the previous-versus-current descriptor-state reference, and the active diff reason so shell, editor, command-palette, write-review, AI / automation, CLI / export, and support surfaces can show current-versus-previous constrained-object state rather than re-reading raw descriptors by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a class's constrained-file-state by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
